recap: Family, Episode 9 — "Wilder Than a Cat in a Bathtub" — delivered on a promise I made these castaways on Day 1: the million-dollar coin flip is back. And who raised his hand? Lewis. The Irishman who ate well, won everything, and knew it. After Devin hit him with some weaponized honesty, Lewis saw the writing on the wall — "I almost dug my own grave by being so good at these challenges" — and chose to embrace the chaos at Tribal. He called fire. The coin said water. Safety, an idol, and two million dollars, gone in one spin, and Lewis became our third member of the jury on Day 17. Elsewhere, Carter claimed individual immunity, Devin, Eric, Lewis, Mike and Thien An feasted on reward, and Sharonda quietly took credit for last week's Tribal — "just not out loud right now." That's the game, people.
bullets: Lewis called fire, the coin came up water, and a 50/50 shot at safety, an idol, and $2 million vanished in an instant.
Carter wore the individual immunity necklace and never had to sweat a single vote.
Devin, Eric, Lewis, Mike and Thien An cashed in on reward — nobody is starving out there this season.
Sharonda revealed she tipped off Devin and Jelly and wrote their names down anyway: "I'm taking all this credit for the Tribal, just not out loud right now."
Devin "found" his own fake idol and tried to hand it to Maggie — she refused, and the whole thing turned into a comedy show.
draftImpact: Tim, you're still on top at 59, up 3 — but it cost you, because Lewis is the one who flipped that coin and walked out the door; you've got 3 of 4 still standing. Tami, a tidy +3 to 48 and second place with 3 of your 5 alive. Austin, +2 to 40 with Carter's immunity run continuing. Kylie, +1 to 33, down to one castaway. Taylor, flat at 31 with nobody left in the game — tough beach, my friend.
